```{r, echo = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)  
library(MASS)

```

```{r, echo = FALSE}
raw_data <- read.csv("AirBnB.csv", header = TRUE)
```

```{r, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, results = 'hide'}
# 1) Area for Amsterdam, North Holland, Netherlands
# Keep ONLY the variables needed to build the 9 predictors
#    (keep 'room_type' now and make dummies in step 3)
base <- raw_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(city)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(state)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(country)) %>%
  
  mutate(
    city_clean = case_when(
      city == "Amsterdam" ~ "Amsterdam",
   
    ),
    
    state_clean = case_when(
      state %in% c("North Holland", "Noord-Holland", "NH") ~ "North Holland",
     
    ),
    
    country_clean = case_when(
      country == "Netherlands" ~ "Netherlands",
    
    )
  )  %>%
  
  filter(!is.na(city_clean)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(state_clean)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(country_clean)) %>%
  
    dplyr::select(price, accommodates, room_type, number_of_reviews,
         review_scores_rating, host_response_rate, host_response_time)

# 2) drop rows where any kept character field is just spaces, then drop NAs
base_clean <- base %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.character),
                ~ na_if(str_trim(str_to_lower(.)), ""))) %>%  
  mutate(across(where(is.character),
                ~ na_if(., "na"))) %>% 
  drop_na() 

# 3) minimal numeric conversions
#    - strip "$" and "," from price, then make numeric
base_num <- base_clean %>%
  mutate(
    price                = parse_number(price),
    accommodates         = as.numeric(accommodates),
    number_of_reviews    = as.numeric(number_of_reviews),
    review_scores_rating = as.numeric(review_scores_rating),
    host_response_rate   = as.numeric(host_response_rate),
  ) %>% drop_na(price, accommodates, number_of_reviews,
           review_scores_rating, host_response_rate, room_type)

# 4) Build dummy variables for room_type:
#    Private room and Shared room (Entire home/apt is the baseline with both 0)
base_new_var <- base_num %>%
 mutate(
    private_room = if_else(room_type == "private room", 1, 0, missing = NA_real_),
    shared_room  = if_else(room_type == "shared room",  1, 0, missing = NA_real_),

    # --- NEW: host response time dummies (baseline: "within a day") ---
    # Normalize to lower-case for robust matching
    host_response_time_lc = stringr::str_to_lower(host_response_time),
    hr_within_hour        = if_else(host_response_time_lc == "within an hour",        1, 0, missing = NA_real_),
    hr_within_few_hours   = if_else(host_response_time_lc == "within a few hours",    1, 0, missing = NA_real_),
    hr_few_days_or_more   = if_else(host_response_time_lc == "a few days or more",    1, 0, missing = NA_real_)
    # baseline (not included): "within a day"  -> all three dummies = 0
  )

# 5) Create the required interaction predictors
#    X1:X2, X1:X3, and X4:X5
clean_airbnb_data <- base_new_var %>%
  mutate(
    Price = price,
    Accommodates  = accommodates,
    Private_Room = private_room,       # categorical dummy
    Shared_Room = shared_room,        # categorical dummy
    Number_of_Reviews = number_of_reviews,
    Review_Scores_Rating  = review_scores_rating,
    Host_Response_Rate  = host_response_rate,
    `Accommodates:Private_Room` = Accommodates * Private_Room,
    `Accommodates:Shared_Room` = Accommodates * Shared_Room,
    `Number_of_Reviews:Review_Scores_Rating` = Number_of_Reviews * Review_Scores_Rating,
  ) %>%

# 6) Keep ONLY the nine predictors need for modeling
   dplyr::select(Price, Accommodates, Private_Room, Shared_Room, `Accommodates:Private_Room`, `Accommodates:Shared_Room`, Number_of_Reviews, Review_Scores_Rating, `Number_of_Reviews:Review_Scores_Rating`, Host_Response_Rate, hr_within_hour, hr_within_few_hours, hr_few_days_or_more) %>%
  drop_na()

# 7) Display the first few rows of the dataset
head(clean_airbnb_data)

# 8) Show the structure of the dataset (variable types and first few values)
str(clean_airbnb_data)
nrow(clean_airbnb_data)
sum(complete.cases(clean_airbnb_data))
table(base_num$room_type, useNA = "ifany")
table(base_num$host_response_time, useNA = "ifany")
```

```{r, echo = FALSE}
# Transformation(part 1 y response is violated)
clean_airbnb_data <- clean_airbnb_data %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(
    ln_price         = log(Price),                    
    ln_num_reviews   = log(Number_of_Reviews ),     
    review_score_sq  = Review_Scores_Rating^2,
  host_response_sq = Host_Response_Rate^2 
  )
Tran_model <- lm(ln_price ~ Accommodates + Private_Room + Shared_Room + `Accommodates:Private_Room` + `Accommodates:Shared_Room` + ln_num_reviews  +     review_score_sq + ln_num_reviews: review_score_sq +  host_response_sq  + hr_within_hour + hr_within_few_hours + hr_few_days_or_more, data = clean_airbnb_data )


```

```{r, echo = FALSE}
stepAIC(Tran_model, direction = "both", k=2)
```

```{r, echo = FALSE}
model_auto <-lm(formula = ln_price ~ Accommodates + Private_Room + Shared_Room + 
    `Accommodates:Private_Room` + `Accommodates:Shared_Room` + 
    ln_num_reviews + review_score_sq + hr_within_hour + hr_within_few_hours + 
    hr_few_days_or_more + ln_num_reviews:review_score_sq, data = clean_airbnb_data)

```

```{r, echo = FALSE}

anova_res <- anova(model_auto, Tran_model) ## --- Model comparison: transformed full vs auto model ---


f_tab <- tibble::tibble(
  Comparison = "Full vs Auto(reduced) model",
  Extra_term = "ln_host_response",       
  df_num     = anova_res$Df[2],
  df_den     = anova_res$Res.Df[2],
  F          = anova_res$F[2],
  p_value    = anova_res$`Pr(>F)`[2]
)

f_tab

f_tab %>%
  mutate(
    F       = round(F, 3),
    p_value = round(p_value, 3)
  ) %>%
  kable(
    caption = "Nested F-test comparing transformed full model and Auto model",
    align   = c("l", "l", "c", "c", "c", "c")
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(
    full_width = FALSE,
    position   = "center",
    bootstrap_options = c("condensed", "bordered")
  )
```

```{r}
model_final <- lm(formula = ln_price ~ Accommodates + Private_Room + Shared_Room + 
    `Accommodates:Private_Room` + `Accommodates:Shared_Room` + 
    ln_num_reviews +  review_score_sq  + hr_within_hour + hr_within_few_hours + 
    hr_few_days_or_more , data = clean_airbnb_data)

vif_final<-vif(model_final)
vif_tab <- data.frame(
  Predictor = names(vif_final),
  VIF       = as.numeric(vif_final)
)

vif_tab %>%
  mutate(VIF = round(VIF, 2)) %>%   
  arrange(desc(VIF)) %>%          
  kable(
    caption = "Impact of multicollinearity on coefficient variance in the model_final",
    align   = c("l", "c")
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(
    full_width = FALSE,
    position   = "center",
    bootstrap_options = c("condensed", "bordered")
  )

```


```{r}
n_tran   <- nrow(model.frame(Tran_model))
n_final  <- nrow(model.frame(model_final))
n_tran 
n_final 
p_tran   <- length(coef(Tran_model)) -1
p_final  <- length(coef(model_final)) -1
p_tran 
p_final
## Adjusted R^2
adjR2_tran  <- summary(Tran_model)$adj.r.squared
adjR2_final <- summary(model_final)$adj.r.squared

## AIC
AIC_tran  <- extractAIC(Tran_model,  k = 2)[2]
AIC_final <- extractAIC(model_final, k = 2)[2]

## AICc
AICc_tran  <- AIC_tran  + (2 * (p_tran+2)  * (p_tran  + 3)) / (n_tran  - p_tran  - 1)
AICc_final <- AIC_final + (2 * (p_final+2) * (p_final + 3)) / (n_final - p_final - 1)

## BIC（k = log(n)）
BIC_tran  <- extractAIC(Tran_model,  k = log(n_tran ))[2]
BIC_final <- extractAIC(model_final, k = log(n_final))[2]

lik_tab <- data.frame(
  Model   = c("Tran_model", "model_final"),
  Adj_R2  = c(adjR2_tran,   adjR2_final),
  AIC     = c(AIC_tran,     AIC_final),
  AICc    = c(AICc_tran,    AICc_final),
  BIC     = c(BIC_tran,     BIC_final)
)

lik_tab
lik_tab %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 3))) %>% 
  kable(caption = "Comparison of Tran_model and model_final") %>%
  kable_styling(
    full_width = FALSE,
    position   = "center",
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed", "bordered") 
  )
```


```{r all_plots, fig.show="hold", out.width="90%", fig.height=5, fig.width=8, fig.align="center", echo=FALSE}
## ========== Diagnostics for Final Model ==========
## ================= Check assumptions (two conditions) =================
e_hat <- resid(model_final)
y_hat <- fitted(model_final)


## =================Pairs plot (scatterplot matrix) for predictors =================
names(model.frame(model_final))
pairs(
  model.frame(model_final)[ , c(
    "Accommodates",
    "Private_Room",
    "Shared_Room",
    "ln_num_reviews",
    "review_score_sq",
    "hr_within_hour" ,
    "hr_within_few_hours",
     "hr_few_days_or_more"   
  )],
  main = "Pairs Plot of Predictors",
  pch  = 19,
  cex  = 0.5,
  col  = "grey40"
)
## ---------- Fitted vs Actual ln-Price ----------
par(mfrow = c(1, 2), mar = c(4, 4, 2, 1))

plot(
  x = y_hat,
  y = model.frame(model_final)$ln_price,   
  pch  = 19,
  cex  = 0.7,
  main = "Fitted Values vs Actual ln_Price",
  xlab = "Fitted (Predicted) ln_Price",
  ylab = "Actual ln_Price"
)
abline(a = 0, b = 1, col = "blue", lwd = 2, lty = 2)
#Normal Q-Q plot
qqnorm(e_hat,
       main = "Normal Q-Q")
qqline(e_hat)

```

```{r leverage_hist, fig.height=4, fig.width=6}

# checking problematic observations 
# problematic observations
p = length(coef(model_final))-1
n = nrow(model.frame(model_final))
n
p 
# leverage
cutoff1 <- 2*((p+1)/n)
cutoff1
hii <- hatvalues(model_final)
high_lev_index <- which(hii > cutoff1)
high_lev_index
plot(
  x = 1:length(hii),
  y = hii,
  xlab = "Observation index",
  ylab = "Leverage (h_ii)",
  main = "Leverage values for the final model"
)
abline(h = cutoff1, col = "red", lty = 2)     # cutoff1 = 2*(p+1)/n
points(high_lev_index, hii[high_lev_index],
       col = "red", pch = 19)

```

```{r rstd_plot, fig.height=4, fig.width=6}
# outlier
ri <- rstandard(model_final) 
# n >> 50
outliers_index <- which (ri > 4 | ri < -4)
outliers_index
plot(
  x = 1:length(ri),
  y = ri,
  xlab = "Observation index",
  ylab = "Standardized residual",
  main = "Outliers for the final model"
)
abline(h = 0,          col = "grey40")
abline(h = c(-4, 4),   col = "red", lty = 2)   
points(outliers_index, ri[outliers_index],
       col = "red", pch = 19)
```

```{r cooks_plot_final, echo=FALSE}
 # cook's distance

cook_influential

)
```

```{r DFFITS, fig.height=4, fig.width=6,echo=FALSE, message = FALSE}
 # DFFITS
cutoff3 <- 2*sqrt((p+1)/n)
cutoff3
DFFITS <- dffits(model_final)
DFFITS_influential <-which(dffits(model_final) > cutoff3 | dffits(model_final) < -1*cutoff3)
DFFITS_influential
plot(
  x = 1:length(DFFITS),
  y = DFFITS,
  xlab = "Observation index",
  ylab = "DFFITS",
  main = "DFFITS for the final model"
)
abline(h = c(-cutoff3, cutoff3), col = "red", lty = 2)  # cutoff3 = 2*sqrt((p+1)/n)
points(DFFITS_influential, DFFITS[DFFITS_influential],
       col = "red", pch = 19)
```

```{r DFBETAS, fig.height=4, fig.width=6,echo=FALSE}
#DFBETAS
DFBETAS <- dfbetas(model_final) 
cutoff4 <- 2/sqrt(n)
cutoff4
DFBETAS_influential <- abs(dfbetas(model_final))>cutoff4
DFBETAS_influential
max_dfbetas <- apply(DFBETAS, 1, function(x) max(abs(x)))

plot(
  x = 1:length(max_dfbetas),
  y = max_dfbetas,
  xlab = "Observation index",
  ylab = "max |DFBETA|",
  main = "Maximum |DFBETA| across coefficients"
)
abline(h = cutoff4, col = "red", lty = 2)  # cutoff4 = 2/sqrt(n)
points(which(max_dfbetas > cutoff4),
       max_dfbetas[max_dfbetas > cutoff4],
       col = "red", pch = 19)
```
 

```{r prob_plots, fig.height=6, fig.width=10, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.show="hold"}
par(mfrow = c(2, 3), mar = c(4, 4, 2, 1))   
p = length(coef(model_final)) - 1
n = nrow(model.frame(model_final))
cutoff1 <- 2 * ((p + 1) / n)

plot(
  x = 1:length(hii),
  y = hii,
  xlab = "Observation index",
  ylab = "Leverage (h_ii)",
  main = "Leverage values for the final model"
)

points(high_lev_index, hii[high_lev_index], col = "red", pch = 19)

# 2) standardized residuals

outliers_index <- which(ri > 4 | ri < -4)

plot(
  x = 1:length(ri),
  y = ri,
  xlab = "Observation index",
  ylab = "Standardized residual",

)

  y = di,
  xlab = "Observation index",

)
```

```{r coef_table_simple, message=FALSE,echo=FALSE}

                               "Significant", "Not significant")
```
